LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_CycleDescription: Remove every drug addiction and drug tolerance from the occupant. Withdrawal ends with the addiction that causes it. Permanent addictions such as luciferium cannot be cured.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_LetterText: {0} has completed detox treatment in the biosculpter pod. Every drug addiction and drug tolerance that could be treated has been removed.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_NoConditionsLetterText: {0} has completed the detox cycle, but had no drug addictions or drug tolerances to treat. The cycle had no effect.
LanguageData.BiosculpterDetox_NoConditionsToTreat: No addictions or drug tolerances detected. The cycle will complete without effect.
